label: Filesystem
description: Analyse Natan's trade notes and build a virtual filesystem with cities, people, and goods directories.

steps.label: Fetch API help
steps.detail: Call help action to discover available filesystem API operations

steps.label: Download notes
steps.detail: Download and extract natan_notes.zip from the hub

steps.label: AI analysis
steps.detail: LLM reads all notes and extracts cities (needs+sells), people, and goods-for-sale

steps.label: Build filesystem
steps.detail: Reset, then batch-create /miasta /osoby /towary directories and all files in one request

steps.label: Verify and get flag
steps.detail: Call done — hub validates the filesystem structure and returns the flag if correct
